titleEn: Minimum Interval to Include Each Query
title: 包含每个查询的最小区间
summary: 对每个查询点，返回包含它的最短闭区间长度，无区间包含则负一。
insight: 区间按左端点、查询按值排序。处理查询时加入所有 left<=query 的区间到按长度排序的堆，再移除 right<query 的过期区间，堆顶即最短。
pitfalls: 答案需写回查询原顺序
堆中区间可能因右端过期失效

solutions.title: 离线查询与区间小根堆
solutions.idea: 沿查询坐标单调扫描并维护当前包含候选。
steps: intervals 按 left 排序，query 下标按值排序

code.java: class Solution { public int[] minInterval(int[][] intervals,int[] queries){Arrays.sort(intervals,Comparator.comparingInt(a->a[0]));Integer[] order=new Integer[queries.length];for(int i=0;i<order.length;i++)order[i]=i;Arrays.sort(order,Comparator.comparingInt(i->queries[i]));PriorityQueue<int[]> heap=new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(a->a[0]));int[] answer=new int[queries.length];Arrays.fill(answer,-1);int next=0;for(int index:order){int value=queries[index];while(next<intervals.length&&intervals[next][0]<=value){heap.offer(new int[]{intervals[next][1]-intervals[next][0]+1,intervals[next][1]});next++;}while(!heap.isEmpty()&&heap.peek()[1]<value)heap.poll();if(!heap.isEmpty())answer[index]=heap.peek()[0];}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minInterval(intervals:Array<IntArray>,queries:IntArray):IntArray{intervals.sortBy{it[0]};val order=queries.indices.sortedBy{queries[it]};val heap=java.util.PriorityQueue<IntArray>(compareBy{it[0]});val answer=IntArray(queries.size){-1};var next=0;for(index in order){val value=queries[index];while(next<intervals.size&&intervals[next][0]<=value){heap.add(intArrayOf(intervals[next][1]-intervals[next][0]+1,intervals[next][1]));next++};while(heap.isNotEmpty()&&heap.peek()[1]<value)heap.remove();if(heap.isNotEmpty())answer[index]=heap.peek()[0]};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<int> minInterval(vector<vector<int>>& intervals,vector<int>& queries){sort(intervals.begin(),intervals.end());vector<int> order(queries.size());iota(order.begin(),order.end(),0);sort(order.begin(),order.end(),[&](int a,int b){return queries[a]<queries[b];});priority_queue<pair<int,int>,vector<pair<int,int>>,greater<pair<int,int>>> heap;vector<int> answer(queries.size(),-1);int next=0;for(int index:order){int value=queries[index];while(next<(int)intervals.size()&&intervals[next][0]<=value){heap.push({intervals[next][1]-intervals[next][0]+1,intervals[next][1]});++next;}while(!heap.empty()&&heap.top().second<value)heap.pop();if(!heap.empty())answer[index]=heap.top().first;}return answer;} };
